description.zh:
数组作业配置。
> 数组作业索引值会通过环境变量`EHPC_ARRAY_TASK_ID`传入Serverless作业容器中，支持用户业务程序访问。
description.en:
The configuration of the array job.

>  The value of an array job index is passed to a serverless job container through the environment variable `EHPC_ARRAY_TASK_ID`. Users can access the container from business programs.

description.zh:
集群ID。

您可以通过调用[ListClusters](~~87116~~)获取集群ID。
description.en:
The cluster ID.

You can call the [ListClusters](~~87116~~) operation to query the cluster ID.
The properties of the Serverless job container.

description.zh: Serverless作业容器的vCPU大小。单位：核。
description.en: The vCPU size of the serverless job container. Unit: cores.
The dependencies of the serverless job.
The ID of the dependent job.

description.zh:
依赖类型。取值范围：

- AfterSucceeded：所依赖作业或数组作业**所有子任务**运行成功（退出码为0）。
- AfterFailed：所依赖作业或数组作业**任一子任务**运行失败（退出码非0）。
- AfterAny：所依赖作业运行结束（成功或失败）。
- AfterCorresponding：所依赖数组作业对应的子任务运行成功（退出码为0）。

默认值：AfterSucceeded。
description.en:
The dependency type. Valid values:

*   AfterSucceeded: **All subtasks** of the dependent job or array job succeed. The exit code is 0.
*   AfterFailed: **All subtasks** of the dependent job or array job fail. The exit code is not 0.
*   AfterAny: The dependent job completes (succeeds or fails).
*   AfterCorresponding: The subtask corresponding to the dependent array job succeeds. The exit code is 0.

Default value: AfterSucceeded.

description.zh:
为Serverless作业容器增加的临时存储空间大小。单位：GiB。
> Serverless作业容器默认提供30 GiB的免费存储空间，如果您的存储需求大于30 GiB，可以通过该参数自定义增加临时存储空间大小。
description.en:
The size of the temporary storage space added to the serverless job container. Unit: GiB.

>  By default, a space of 30 GiB is provided free of charge. If you require a larger space, you can pass this parameter to specify your required space size.

description.zh: Serverless作业容器所采用的ECS实例规格列表。
description.en: The Elastic Compute Service (ECS) instance types used by the serverless job container.

description.zh:
Serverless作业名。
> 支持英文小写字母、数字或者短划线（-），不能以短划线开头或者结尾。
description.en:
The name of the serverless job.

>  The name can contain lowercase letters, digits, and hyphens (-). It cannot start or end with a hyphen.

description.zh: Serverless作业的调度优先级。取值范围：0~999，取值越大，优先级越高。
description.en: The scheduling priority of the serverless job. Valid values: 0 to 999. A greater value indicates a higher priority.

description.zh: Serverless作业容器的内存大小。单位：GiB。
description.en: The memory size of the serverless job container. Unit: GiB.

description.zh: Serverless作业容器绑定的RAM角色名称。
description.en: The Resource Access Manamement (RAM) role that is associated with the Serverless job container.
The retry policy of the serverless job.

description.zh:
设置抢占式实例的每小时最高价格，最多精确到小数点后3位。

当SpotStrategy取值为SpotWithPriceLimit时，必须设置SpotPriceLimit。
description.en:
The maximum hourly price of the preemptible elastic container instance. The value can be accurate to three decimal places.

If you set SpotStrategy to SpotWithPriceLimit, you must specify the SpotPriceLimit parameter.

description.zh:
实例的抢占策略。取值范围：

- NoSpot：正常按量付费实例。
- SpotWithPriceLimit：设置上限价格的抢占式实例。
- SpotAsPriceGo：系统自动出价，跟随当前市场实际价格的抢占式实例。

默认值：NoSpot。
description.en:
The bidding policy of the ECS instances. Valid values:

*   NoSpot: The instance is created as a pay-as-you-go instance.
*   SpotWithPriceLimit: The instance is created as a preemptible instance for which you specify the maximum hourly price.
*   SpotAsPriceGo: The instance is created as a preemptible instance for which the market price at the time of purchase is automatically used as the bid price.

Default value: NoSpot.

description.zh: Serverless作业的有效期限，超出该时间后，作业会强制终止。单位为秒。
description.en: The validity period of the serverless job. After the validity period expires, the job is forcibly terminated. Unit: seconds.

description.zh: Serverless作业容器所属的交换机ID列表。
description.en: The IDs of the vSwitches to which the serverless job container belongs.
